title: Euler-Poincaré Formulation of Barotropic Fluids Coupled with ADM Gravity
summary: This paper develops a geometric mechanics framework for the reduction of general relativistic hydrodynamic variational principles, from the variation of worldlines approach in 4D spacetime to 3-dimensional Eulerian descriptions. We consider a self-gravitating, barotropic fluid and obtain the Euler-Poincaré equations of the system by Lagrangian reduction.
